`PPSV_Submission_form.xlsx` is the source reference for the service-submission
contract. The application preserves its 18 required and eight optional fields.
This chapter records the runtime labels, storage keys, controls, and validation
rules so form, migration, test, and PDF changes can be reviewed against one
contract.

## Request type selector

The selector is required and has an empty default. Its UI choices are the eight
service modules below followed by `General inquiry / consultation`. Selecting
a service shows its description, a safe HTTPS link, and the common protein
form. General inquiry uses a separate conditional form and is not inserted into
the `service_modules` table.

### Seeded service modules

The order, names, descriptions, and URLs below match the version-controlled
seed data.

1. **Molecular cloning** — Molecular cloning assists you with access to a
   series of vectors and protocols for single - or multigene assembly. An
   online primer design tool is available for cloning into the parallel pCoofy
   vector series. [Service page](https://max.mpg.de/sites/biochem/Forschungsservice/Protein-Production/Seiten/Molecular-Cloning.aspx)
2. **Host repertoire for expression optimization** — With our expression host
   repertoire including bacteria, yeast, insect and mammalian cells we will
   identify the system most appropriate for your target protein. Parallel
   screening aims at achieving high expression levels of cytoplasmic or
   secreted proteins. [Service page](https://max.mpg.de/sites/biochem/Forschungsservice/Protein-Production/Seiten/Host-repertoire.aspx)
3. **Large Scale Production** — We produce bacteria and yeast at high cell
   density in stirred tank reactors from 1 to 10 L including protocols for
   metabolic labelling. Insect and mammalian cells are cultivated in shake
   flasks up to 5 L scale. [Service page](https://max.mpg.de/sites/biochem/Forschungsservice/Protein-Production/Seiten/Up-scale-production.aspx)
4. **Protein Purification** — We establish a purification strategy for your
   target protein if no protocols are available. In addition to standard
   chromatography procedures (affinity, IEX and SEC) we apply special protocols
   like additive screens, protein refolding etc for difficult targets.
   [Service page](https://max.mpg.de/sites/biochem/Forschungsservice/Protein-Production/Seiten/Protein-Purification.aspx)
5. **Protein Analysis** — As final quality control of the delivered protein,
   we routinely assess purity, intact mass and integrity / homogeneity by
   SDS-PAGE, LC-MS, DLS + analytical gel filtration. Additional characterization
   like CD-spectroscopy or nanoDSF is performed if required.
   [Service page](https://max.mpg.de/sites/biochem/Forschungsservice/Protein-Production/Seiten/Quality-Control.aspx)
6. **Macromolecular Crystallisation** — Automated Macromolecular cristallisation
   screening and optimisation.
   [Service page](https://max.mpg.de/sites/biochem/Forschungsservice/Protein-Production/Seiten/Macromolecular%20Crystallisation.aspx)
7. **X-Ray Crystallography** — We characterize macromolecular crystals using
   X-Ray Crystallography.
   [Service page](https://max.mpg.de/sites/biochem/Forschungsservice/Protein-Production/Seiten/Crystallography.aspx)
8. **Structure Modeling and Validation** — We can refine build and validate
   macromolecular structures (X-ray and CryoEM). We can also support the
   depostion of structure to the Protein Data Bank.
   [Service page](https://max.mpg.de/sites/biochem/Forschungsservice/Protein-Production/Seiten/Structure%20Modelling%20and%20Validation.aspx)

External links must remain HTTPS URLs from the seeded catalogue and open as
ordinary external links; request data is never appended to them.

## Required service fields

All 18 fields are required for every service request. Literal `N/A` is accepted
for a mandatory textual scientific field when the selected service genuinely
makes it inapplicable. `N/A` is not a substitute for contact information or a
required positive number.

| # | Display label | Storage key | Control and rule |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | Name | `contact_name` | Text; LDAP value is read-only and verified. A missing LDAP value may be entered and is marked unverified. |
| 2 | E-mail | `contact_email` | Valid email syntax; LDAP value is read-only and verified. A manual value is marked unverified. |
| 3 | Research group | `research_group` | Text, prefilled when LDAP provides it. |
| 4 | Phone | `phone` | Text, prefilled when LDAP provides it. |
| 5 | Billing code | `billing_code` | Text. It is project attribution only; the system does not calculate costs. |
| 6 | Protein name | `protein_name` | Text. |
| 7 | UniProt ID | `uniprot_id` | Text. |
| 8 | Source organism | `source_organism` | Text. |
| 9 | Expression construct | `expression_construct` | Multiline text. |
| 10 | Tag(s) | `tags` | Text. |
| 11 | Expression host | `expression_host` | Text. |
| 12 | Antibiotic resistance | `antibiotic_resistance` | Text. |
| 13 | Storage buffer | `storage_buffer` | Multiline text. |
| 14 | References / previous experiments | `references_previous_experiments` | Multiline text; URLs, citations, and line breaks are preserved. |
| 15 | Amount required (mg) | `amount_required_mg` | Number strictly greater than zero. |
| 16 | Final concentration required (mg/mL) | `final_concentration_mg_ml` | Number strictly greater than zero. |
| 17 | Delivery | `delivery_state` | One of `Frozen` or `Unfrozen`. |
| 18 | Aliquot size | `aliquot_size` | Text because the workbook does not define one unit; requester must include value and unit. |

## Optional service fields

The following eight fields may be blank.

| # | Display label | Storage key | Control and rule |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | Size uncleaved (Da) | `size_uncleaved_da` | Optional number; strictly greater than zero when supplied. |
| 2 | Size cleaved (Da) | `size_cleaved_da` | Optional number; strictly greater than zero when supplied. |
| 3 | Cleavage Size | `cleavage_size` | Optional text because its unit/meaning is not defined; include value and unit when supplied. |
| 4 | Sequence (uncleaved) | `sequence_uncleaved` | Optional multiline text. |
| 5 | Sequence (cleaved) | `sequence_cleaved` | Optional multiline text. |
| 6 | Purification strategy | `purification_strategy` | Optional multiline text. |
| 7 | Tag removal required? | `tag_removal_required` | Nullable selector: blank, `Yes`, or `No`. |
| 8 | Localisation | `localisation` | Optional text. |

Unicode and multiline values are retained in the database and PPSV PDF. The PDF
also includes request/module information, current status and history, and the
file manifest; it contains no price, cost, or invoice section.

## General inquiry / consultation

Choosing General inquiry hides every protein field and the billing code. The
required fields are:

- Name
- E-mail
- Research group
- Phone
- Subject
- Message

The requester may select one optional related service and attach optional
files. The item is saved as `request_kind = inquiry` with one inquiry-detail
row and receives its ID from the same concurrency-safe sequence as service
requests.

## Contact verification and mail use

LDAP-provided name and email are read-only. If LDAP omits either attribute, the
requester may enter it manually and the stored contact snapshot remains visibly
unverified. An editable form email is never used as SMTP `From`, `Reply-To`, or
an acknowledgement recipient. Only the verified LDAP email associated with the
authenticated login may be used for those purposes.

## Editing rules

An owner may edit their own request until it is `Closed`, and staff may edit
all non-archived requests. Status and assignment are staff-only. Request edits
do not overwrite the authenticated owner or silently turn a staff member into
the contact. Every status change records the actor, UTC timestamp, and an
optional note.
